key_insight: Constrained Deep Ritz solvers perform best among the tested neural approaches for 1D soliton profiles, with the Weinstein variant offering the best error–runtime balance.
engineering_relevance: Mesh-free neural solvers offer a proof of concept for tackling more complex nonlinearities, dispersive operators, and higher-dimensional problems.
method: Enhance Adam-trained PINNs with Gauss–Newton/Levenberg–Marquardt, L-BFGS refinements, and Fourier features.
Learn profile amplitude through a Nehari/Pokhozhaev-constrained Deep Ritz formulation.
Minimize the Weinstein quotient using a normalized neural profile.
evidence_signal: Explicit sech-type solutions provide exact references for error computation and hyperparameter benchmarking, with classical Petviashvili iteration serving as a comparator.
watch_item: In 1D, the neural solvers remain less accurate and efficient than Petviashvili iteration; advantages in higher dimensions are not established here.
paper_title: Soliton Profiles in 1D: Enhanced Neural-Network Solvers and Constrained Deep Ritz Methods
